ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Stratagem.cs:11-14) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars, no animation trigger.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<StratagemPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Stratagem.cs:18) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, StratagemPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Literal 1 on both sides. StratagemPower's on-shuffle selection is the power stream's -- and note card/cascade's record already cites it by name: an AfterShuffle listener that drains the draw pile is exactly the case Cascade's pull loop has to tolerate, and both sides do.
